content: With G-STT, our best model obtained ROUGE-1 F1 of 71.75 (which equals to percentage of times dosage is correct in this case) for Dosage extraction and 40.13 for Frequency extraction tasks. To measure the percentage of times the correct frequency was extracted by the model, we qualitatively compared the extracted and predicted frequency. We find that for 73.58% of the medications the model can find the correct frequency from the transcripts.
